name: a wall of topic pills drifts behind a held claim
looks: Rows of small rounded tag pills, each naming a different topic, fill the frame and drift sideways at a slow, steady pace, different rows at slightly different speeds. A bold headline sits perfectly still on top of the drift.
build: Pills are a looped, repeating row (x wraps modulo total width); each row's speed is a small uneven multiple of a base rate for parallax; the headline is a fixed layer above with a soft shadow to stay legible.
sound: A soft, continuous low shimmer under the drift, no individual hits.
prompt: Fill the frame with rows of small topic pills drifting sideways at slightly different speeds, with a bold, perfectly still headline held over the top, to show the breadth of subjects covered behind one simple claim.
